findings.summary: Clause 3 (at U_0=0 the three E bumps prescribe (I,S,C_p) and preserve M,J) is not one declaration in the five-moment setting; it follows in a few lines from the stated five-moment declarations, and holds as a separate E-only construction.

Within FiveProfileMoments the moments are full-axis increments rather than cumulative \int_0^X (the cumulative form lives elsewhere and is bridged), and the U and E bumps are forced into disjoint halves of the correction interval, removing the mixed U-E term from the quadratic form.
